create.name: Whitney Freya
create.bio:
Whitney Freya is an artist, author and teacher of sacred painting, a practice that uses painting as meditation and as a way into intuition and spiritual life. In 1996, at 26 and with no art training, she opened an art centre and only then began to paint herself; for around thirty years since she has taught people who believe they cannot paint to work freely with colour, symbol and brush. She founded the Creatively Fit Coaching programme, now called Creative Frequency Coach Training, which has certified hundreds of coaches since 2010, and she created the first painting meditation course on DailyOM. She has taught at Esalen, Kripalu, Burning Man and Agape.

Her online courses include painting meditations on the Buddhist deity Tara and on the Buddha, the Vision Quest programme built around the four elements, and Super Soul Flow, which combines guided meditation with painting. She has written four books on personal creativity, among them Rise Above and 30 Days to Unstoppable, and offers free guided meditations through her Dreams Made Visible app. She also leads art retreats abroad and founded the Great Mother March, a walking pilgrimage devoted to the Earth and the sacred feminine. She lives in north-east Oregon, where she paints and flies a paraglider, and teaches Heal Through Sacred Painting on The Shift Network.

books.title: 30 Days to Unstoppable: Be the Dream Made Visible
books.author: Whitney Freya
books.description: A thirty-day meditative practice for creating what you want to experience in your outer life by first creating it within yourself. Each day builds what she calls the Unstoppable Dream meditation, and companion guided meditations are free in her Dreams Made Visible app.

courses.title: Heal Through Sacred Painting
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced video course in painting as a meditative and spiritual practice, open to complete beginners. It covers acrylic basics, intuitive painting and working with sacred symbols such as the Buddha and the owl, and participants finish two paintings.

courses.title: Sacred Painting for Beginners
courses.description: A gentle step-by-step online course in intuitive painting for people new to painting. Ten lessons introduce painting as a practice of presence, creativity and spiritual growth.

courses.title: 22 Day Tara Painting Meditation Challenge
courses.description: Twenty-two daily lessons, each pairing a guided meditation with a painting lesson, on the 21 aspects of Tara, the Buddhist deity of compassion. Students learn her mantras, mudras and symbols while building one layered canvas, with live Zoom sessions and a community.

courses.title: Rise Above . A Transformational Painting Challenge
courses.description: A self-paced course of eight painting lessons, each with a workbook, art-journal version and meditation. It uses painting to explore intention, focus, energy and detachment, with monthly drop-in Zoom gatherings.

courses.title: Vision Quest . The Creatively Fit Program
courses.description: A self-paced programme that takes students from 'I can't paint' to painting freely through the four elements of air, fire, water and earth. It covers painting techniques, detachment and intuition, with monthly live group calls.

courses.title: 21 Day Painting Meditation Challenge
courses.description: A short daily watercolour practice of about ten minutes a day, with a five-to-eight-minute video meditation each day. It is meant as a playful way to quiet the inner critic and begin painting.

courses.title: Super Soul Flow
courses.description: An eight-session course that combines guided meditations in nature, conversation and painting to meet different facets of what she calls the infinite self. It is self-paced with monthly live group calls.

courses.title: World Temple Colombia Journey
courses.description: An eleven-day art journey through Medellín and Colombia's Pacific coast with Whitney Freya and her daughter Riley Ferré. Days combine painting, time in nature and practices on beauty, presence and the feminine.

free_resources.title: Dreams Made Visible guided meditation app
free_resources.description: Her guided meditation app for iPhone and Android, free to download with three meditation series included at no cost. The free series include the companion meditations to 30 Days to Unstoppable.
